items.rationale: Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude the cracked pane and its replacement because optional glazing cover is not shown as agreed. The positive figure is a conditional gross estimate only.
Section 1.3 defines drilling to receive the replacement pane or its hardware as glazing work, which section 3.5(b) excludes. The positive figure is a conditional gross estimate only.
Section 3.5(b) excludes fitting the replacement pane even when separately invoiced; the covered table repair does not change that. The positive figure is a conditional gross estimate only.

Sections 3.5(b) and 5.2.1 exclude disposal of the uninsured pane; billing it separately does not make it covered debris removal. The conditional gross estimate uses the comparable pane disposal in Case 8.

items.description: Repair of dented solid-wood side table
items.rationale: The sudden impact is covered under sections 2.6.1 and 4.2.6, independently of the glass damage. Under sections 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.5, the estimate allows €285 gross for localized wood and finish repair, with no scheduled deductible stated.
Sections 3.6(a) and 7.1.9 exclude scratches that predated the loss, even when repaired alongside covered work. The positive figure is a conditional gross estimate only.

Section 7.1.12 allows one attendance by the contractor who carried out the covered table repair. The ordinary €25 gross charge is payable in full, without apportionment for the unrelated scratch touch-up.
Section 7.1.12 excludes a return visit by the same contractor unless approved in advance, and no approval is stated. If approved, the comparable gross attendance charge would be €25.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administrative overhead, including flat rates. The positive figure is a conditional gross estimate only.
